# fsrs_ex

> fsrs_ex is an Elixir port of the scheduler (inference API) of open-spaced-repetition/fsrs-rs v7.0.0. It supports FSRS-7 and FSRS-6, is verified against fixtures recorded from the Rust crate, and uses the fsrs-rs version number as its own.

This file provides LLM-oriented navigation for the repository.

## Project

- [Repository](https://github.com/lulucatdev/fsrs_ex): Source code, release history, and issue tracking.
- [README](https://github.com/lulucatdev/fsrs_ex/blob/main/README.md): Overview, API mapping to fsrs-rs, installation, and usage.
- [Hex package](https://hex.pm/packages/fsrs_ex): Published package metadata and versions.
- [HexDocs](https://hexdocs.pm/fsrs_ex): API documentation.

## Guides

- [Getting started](https://github.com/lulucatdev/fsrs_ex/blob/main/guides/GETTING_STARTED.md): What to store per card and how to review one.
- [Migrating to 7.0](https://github.com/lulucatdev/fsrs_ex/blob/main/guides/MIGRATING_TO_7.md): Breaking changes from 0.1.x (py-fsrs based) and how to convert existing cards.
- [Porting policy](https://github.com/lulucatdev/fsrs_ex/blob/main/guides/PORTING_POLICY.md): Upstream baseline, scope, versioning, and alignment rules.
- [Parity testing](https://github.com/lulucatdev/fsrs_ex/blob/main/guides/PARITY_TESTING.md): Fixture generation, coverage, and tolerance.
- [Release process](https://github.com/lulucatdev/fsrs_ex/blob/main/guides/RELEASE_PROCESS.md): Preflight and publish workflow.

## Source Files

- [Fsrs](https://github.com/lulucatdev/fsrs_ex/blob/main/lib/lulucat/fsrs.ex): Public API and review replay (mirrors `model.rs` and `inference.rs`).
- [FSRS-7 model](https://github.com/lulucatdev/fsrs_ex/blob/main/lib/lulucat/fsrs_model_v7.ex): Dual-trace state update, forgetting curve, and interval solver (mirrors `model_v7.rs`).
- [FSRS-6 model](https://github.com/lulucatdev/fsrs_ex/blob/main/lib/lulucat/fsrs_model_v6.ex): Mirrors `model_v6.rs`.
- [Parameters](https://github.com/lulucatdev/fsrs_ex/blob/main/lib/lulucat/fsrs_parameters.ex): Defaults, legacy expansion, and clipping.
- [MemoryState](https://github.com/lulucatdev/fsrs_ex/blob/main/lib/lulucat/fsrs_memory_state.ex): The per-card state to persist.

## Validation Assets

- [Rust fixture generator](https://github.com/lulucatdev/fsrs_ex/blob/main/test/fixtures/rust_fixture/src/main.rs): Records outputs of the `fsrs` crate.
- [Parity fixture](https://github.com/lulucatdev/fsrs_ex/blob/main/test/fixtures/fsrs_rs_v7_0_0_fixture.json.gz): Gzipped JSON of recorded inputs and outputs.
- [Parity tests](https://github.com/lulucatdev/fsrs_ex/blob/main/test/fsrs_rs_parity_test.exs): Elixir checks against the fixture.

## Optional

- [fsrs-rs upstream](https://github.com/open-spaced-repetition/fsrs-rs): Upstream implementation used as baseline.
- [FSRS algorithm wiki](https://github.com/open-spaced-repetition/fsrs4anki/wiki/The-Algorithm): Algorithm formulas and historical versions.
- [Jarrett Ye (X)](https://x.com/JarrettYe): Primary algorithm author profile.
